how_chosen: Minimized mean train cross-entropy over the weight simplex. The objective is convex in w, so I ran an EM/fixed-point mixture-weight optimizer to convergence (global optimum), after also evaluating all 53130 weight vectors on a 0.05 simplex grid and the 6 one-hot judges. No tie-break was needed; the continuous optimum beat the best grid point (1.52517) slightly.
